title: Velvety Rich Canadian Herring Poutine
description: A rich and umami twist on the classic Canadian poutine dish, featuring herring and topped with a velvety shio-cure sauce. Serve as a comforting dinner or snack.

ingredients.name: herring fillets
ingredients.notes: Look for herring fillets with skin removed for easier cooking

instructions: Dust the herring fillets with flour, shaking off any excess.
Fry the herring fillets in 1 inch of butter until golden brown on both sides, about 4 minutes per side.
Transfer the herring fillets to a baking sheet and cook in the oven for an additional 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, fry the onion and garlic in butter until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced potatoes to the onion mixture and fry for an additional 5 minutes, or until they start to brown.
Increase the oil temperature to 375°F (190°C) and continue frying the potatoes in batches until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per batch.
Drain the potatoes on paper towels and season with salt to taste.
To make the velvety shio-cure sauce, combine the heavy cream and shio-cure mixture in a saucepan and bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Reduce the sauce to 1/2 cup and stir in the grated parmesan cheese until melted.
Serve the herring fillets over the fried potatoes and top with the velvety shio-cure sauce.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley or chives, if desired.
